description: Brave Images. Search Brave Images via API and retrieve structured image results with pagination and SafeSearch. Credit cost: 1 credit per call.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to keep in the response, with dot notation for nested fields (e.g. name,location.city). Does not change the credit cost.

gl.description: Country code (e.g. fr, us). Mapped to Brave country.

hl.description: Language code (e.g. fr, en). Mapped to Brave lang.

page.description: Page number for pagination (50 results per page). Default: 1.

query.description: The search query you want to run on Brave Images.

safe.description: SafeSearch: active | off | moderate | strict. Google-style active maps to Brave strict.

name: brave_images
title: Brave Images
